momTestQuestions.question: Walk me through what happened the last time your forecast missed the quarterly target. Where did the discrepancy come from?
momTestQuestions.probingObjective: Uncover whether bad CRM data hygiene was recognized as the root cause.
momTestQuestions.positiveSignal: Recounts an agonizing weekend spent combing through individual opportunity close dates in spreadsheets.
momTestQuestions.falsePositiveTrap: 'Yeah forecasting is hard, an AI tool that predicts things would be awesome!' (Polite speculation without past pain).

momTestQuestions.question: What have you paid for in the past 12 months to fix CRM hygiene?
momTestQuestions.probingObjective: Verify real willingness to pay by auditing past budget allocation.
momTestQuestions.positiveSignal: Mentions spending $20k on an external RevOps agency or dedicated Zapier/Enrichment seats.
momTestQuestions.falsePositiveTrap: 'We always talk about fixing it, but haven't had time to look.' (Low problem urgency).

momTestQuestions.question: How do your sales reps react when you introduce new required fields in Salesforce?
momTestQuestions.probingObjective: Determine change management resistance and user pushback.
momTestQuestions.positiveSignal: Describes reps actively boycotting or entering garbage dummy text just to pass validation rules.
momTestQuestions.falsePositiveTrap: 'Our team is great, they follow whatever process we set.' (Rarely true in practice).

momTestQuestions.question: Who signs off on sales operations software purchases under $15k?
momTestQuestions.probingObjective: Confirm budget sign-off authority and decision cycle.
momTestQuestions.positiveSignal: VP can approve directly on corporate card without procurement committee.
momTestQuestions.falsePositiveTrap: 'Anyone can propose ideas and we evaluate as a team.' (Indicates long committee paralysis).

unitEconomicsProjection.economicHealthVerdict: Exceptional venture-scale unit economics with rapid sub-5-month payback and healthy 4.9x LTV/CAC ratio.
